title: Windcharge Height Counter
description: Displays how high you are from the ground below
body:
**WindCharge Height Counter**
---
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.gg/3c2qCDbktg) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-1bd96a?logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&style=for-the-badge)](https://modrinth.com/user/Sonionring)
--- Shows your block height from the block directly below you This is made for wind charge movement so you can instantly see how high you are after boosting, jumping, or launching yourself up Works across 1.21 - 1.21.11 in the same jar (1.21.X) Requires: - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) - [YetAnotherConfigLib / YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) Optional BUT recommended to configure: - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) Credit: cutebow (icon and description) ---
**What it does**
--- WindCharge Height Counter adds a HUD that counts your height from the closest solid block directly under you. If you are standing on a block, it shows 0. If you go 8 blocks above that same block, it shows 8, works with howvever high it goes. It does not use your world Y level and it does not count from bedrock, spawn, sea level, or the bottom of the world. It only checks the block directly below you and shows your relative block height from there. ---
**Settings**
--- Uses YACL for the settings screen You can change: - HUD opacity - Background opacity - Text color - Rainbow mode - Gradient mode - Label text - Rounding mode - Decimal places - Show or hide the blocks suffix - Move the counter around with the drag position editor ---
